verdict.rationale: Lithic documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants execute live API requests from the editor (lithic-docs-1, lithic-docs-14, lithic-probe-3). Its agentic-payments blog shows an agent creating virtual cards and configuring authorization rules for MCC, limits and velocity (lithic-docs-11). The API covers card creation, spend limits, and program/account/card-level auth rules (lithic-docs-9, lithic-docs-13, lithic-docs-3). Missing for 10: any evidence of scoped or restricted credentials for agent access, explicit balance and transaction read endpoints, documented card-update operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
